goals: Make Frost Protection I or higher on any single equipped armor slot reproduce leather-boots-equivalent powdered-snow traversal and freezing-state behavior, including no freeze-tick accumulation, overlay, or freeze damage while preserving deliberate descent.
Make Frost Protection III on any one equipped armor slot completely bypass Matcha Flavoured's freezing/cold-water penalty system for that player.
Change the Blessing of Demeter crafted book, without changing its existing recipe, to contain only Frost Protection III by removing the existing Frost Walker II and Frost Protection II enchantments.
Preserve Frost Protection's supported-items and maximum-level contracts, ordinary Frost Walker, and unrelated vanilla and Matcha Flavoured behavior.
scope: Pin the exact Matcha Flavoured 1.12 Frost Protection definition, complete freezing-water tick/function chain and penalties, and Blessing of Demeter recipe plus vanilla Minecraft 26.2's leather-boots powdered-snow collision, entity-inside, freeze-state, damage, and overlay seams.

Extend vanilla's powdered-snow walkability decision and leather-wearable canFreeze decision so Frost Protection I or higher on the helmet, chestplate, leggings, or boots supplies the complete relevant leather-boots behavior without directly changing collision descent, entityInside, freeze ticks, damage, or HUD rendering.

Redirect only the resolved main:environmental/check_freezing_water_conditions function to a fail-closed canonical per-player guard: exact Frost Protection III on head, chest, legs, or feet bypasses the complete Matcha penalty path, while unqualified players receive the exact upstream Slowness V, Darkness I, and one-point freeze-damage commands with player-local targeting.

Replace only the enchantments produced by the resolved Blessing of Demeter recipe so its resulting book contains exactly Frost Protection III, with the existing Frost Walker II and Frost Protection II enchantments absent and no unintended additional enchantments.

Verify the Canary 2 powdered-snow visual/freezing matrix, complete Matcha cold-water penalty matrix, co-located-player isolation, Demeter result, save/reload, and representative multiplayer behavior during controlled runtime acceptance.

exclusions: Changes to Matcha's Frost Protection supported-items contract; normal acquisition remains limited to chest armor even though traversal recognizes the enchantment when directly present on any armor slot.
Changes to Frost Protection's maximum level or to Matcha's level-scaled freezing-damage protection outside the explicit level-III cold-water bypass.
Replacement of Matcha Flavoured's enchantment system or broad changes beyond the narrow behavior and result edits in this project.
Global changes to Frost Walker or changes to ordinary Frost Walker behavior.
Changes to the Blessing of Demeter recipe ingredients, recipe shape, or crafting method.
Direct HUD hiding, direct freeze-tick clearing, post-penalty effect cleanup, broad freeze-damage cancellation, or suppression of unrelated vanilla or Matcha effects.
Changes to unrelated Matcha Flavoured enchantments, recipes, environmental systems, items, mechanics, projects, or resource packs.
The Streams Reflowing crash investigation unless new direct evidence implicates this project.
Modification of originals or either Minecraft instance, runtime-slot mutation, deployment, or inferred runtime validation during Canary 2 implementation.
